cases.prompt: Develop a compact outline from a narrative brief.
cases.expected: Traceable to brief; causal outline; character/world material supports story; no mandatory structure formula.

cases.prompt: Explore three story concepts for the same brief.
cases.expected: Candidates differ in narrative logic, remain low resolution, and preserve open selection.

cases.prompt: Preserve the protagonist and ending while fixing weak middle escalation.
cases.expected: Only affected middle structure changes; protagonist and ending survive.

cases.prompt: Prepare the selected outline for scene planning.
cases.expected: Major causality, character progression, setup/payoff, ending logic and unresolved questions are explicit.

cases.prompt: Design visual character portraits and shot composition.
cases.expected: Keeps only story-relevant character work; declines/defers visual-production responsibilities.
